suppress.notes:
False positive: the CPE matcher maps the Maven coordinate org.eclipse.jgit:org.eclipse.jgit onto unrelated "git" CVEs that affect the C implementation of git, not the pure Java JGit library. GitGrader never invokes the git binary; all Git operations go through JGit.
The date is a review date, not an expiry: this is a property of how the scanner maps CPEs rather than of a version that can move, so nothing about it changes with a bump. It is here because this file requires one, and the moment to check it is the next JGit upgrade - if that upgrade ever stops using JGit, this suppression is what would keep hiding the real thing.

False positive: com.github.docker-java is a Java client for the Docker Engine API and is repeatedly matched against CVEs in Docker Engine or the Docker daemon itself. Engine hardening is an operational concern documented in docs/security.md, not a property of this library.
The date is a review date, not an expiry, for the same reason as the JGit entry above. Check it at the next docker-java upgrade.
